taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said there is little support. What is happening?
Team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages wait until the next morning. Yesterday a customer credit note waited two days because of this.
What would help when handling billing disputes while waiting for your team lead?
A 15-minute fixed slot each day with the lead, or a backup person to ask, would help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire experiences delays with billing tasks because the team lead is unavailable for support throughout the day. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "Team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages wait until the next morning."
